skill.name: imagen
skill.description: Generate image assets with Google Gemini from text prompts for UI, documentation, and visual concept work.
skill.summary: Creates prompt-based PNG image assets for development and documentation workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick findings are Markdown formatting or fenced examples, not executable Ruby backticks. The API key finding is a variable-name requirement rather than a hardcoded secret. The remaining concern is that the skill describes automatic prompt transfer to Google Gemini without a consent or data-handling step.

remediation.issue: Third-party prompt transfer lacks a consent boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Add instructions to confirm before sending prompts or project details to Google Gemini, especially for confidential work.

remediation.issue: API key handling guidance is minimal.
remediation.suggestion: State that API keys must stay in environment variables and must never be pasted into prompts, logs, or generated files.

remediation.issue: The referenced Python script is not included in the package.
remediation.suggestion: Include the script or revise the usage section so agents do not attempt to run a missing local command.

content.value_statement: Design work often needs custom visuals before final assets exist. This skill guides Gemini image generation for PNG assets from clear prompts.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to generate images for UI, documentation, icons, logos, and concept visuals.
Describes a Gemini-based workflow that turns text prompts into PNG files.
Shows Python command examples for basic generation, custom output path, and image size.
Documents the required GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable and Python 3.6+ requirement.
States expected success and failure outputs for generated images.
limitations: The package only contains SKILL.md and does not include the referenced Python script.
It requires a valid GEMINI_API_KEY and access to Google Gemini image generation.
Prompts may be sent to Google Gemini, so sensitive project details need review first.
Output quality, dimensions, and policy behavior depend on the Gemini model.

use_cases.title: Create UI Placeholder Assets
use_cases.description: Generate hero images, avatars, icons, or app visuals while a frontend is still being built.

use_cases.title: Illustrate Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Create visuals for architecture concepts, README sections, and explanatory documentation.

use_cases.title: Explore Product Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Draft visual directions for product screens, launch assets, and early design reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single image asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use imagen to generate a PNG image of [subject] for [project area]. Save it to [path] with a [style] visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Create a UI Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a frontend component asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [asset type] for the [screen or component]. Use [colors], [mood], and [dimensions]. Save it in [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Documentation Visual
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a technical illustration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a documentation-ready illustration of [system or concept]. Include [key parts] and keep labels simple for a README audience.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Constrained Asset
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt with brand, layout, and file constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image for [use case] with [brand constraints], [composition rules], [size], and [accessibility needs]. Save it to [final path].

output_examples.input: Create a hero image for a developer tools landing page.
output_examples.output: A PNG hero image is generated with a polished developer workspace theme and a returned file path.

output_examples.input: Generate a microservices architecture illustration for a README.
output_examples.output: A documentation-ready visual shows services, an API gateway, data stores, and clear relationships.

output_examples.input: Create a minimalist avatar placeholder for a profile component.
output_examples.output: A clean PNG avatar asset is generated for direct use in the UI asset folder.

best_practices: Confirm before sending confidential project context to Google Gemini.
Specify subject, style, dimensions, and target file path in one prompt.
Review generated images for brand, accessibility, and licensing needs before use.
anti_patterns: Do not include secrets, customer data, or private source details in image prompts.
Do not assume the referenced script exists without checking the package contents.
Do not use generated images as final brand assets without human review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides text-to-image generation with Google Gemini for PNG assets used in apps, documentation, and design work.

faq.question: Which API key is required?
faq.answer: The skill expects GEMINI_API_KEY to be available as an environment variable.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No. It depends on access to Google Gemini image generation services.

faq.question: Where are generated images saved?
faq.answer: The skill describes saving PNG files to the current directory or a custom output path.

faq.question: Can I request a specific image size?
faq.answer: Yes. The usage examples show a size option for higher resolution output.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential projects?
faq.answer: Use caution. Prompts may be sent to Google Gemini, so review sensitive details before generation.
